tips.text: Run Circulus, never Yuvarium; it pays more Plasm and roughly doubles the part odds.
Run a full squad; every extra player adds another Thrax, and each has a 30% chance to drop Plasm.
Stay the full 20 minutes each run, then spend banked Plasm only on the parts the drops left missing.
Stop grinding once buying the missing part from Yonta is cheaper; part drops are streaky.
Summon your Necramech for the Thrax waves; it lasts 2 minutes on a 10-minute cooldown.
Bring whatever kills fastest, such as Kullervo or a strong primary for the Thrax and a beam weapon for trash; loot frames do nothing on them.
Ignore a Thrax stuck in spectral form and keep moving, since it drains life support faster and never drops.
Expect a boring five-minute survival loop where the real cost is banking the 50 Plasm to build.
